white-rice-cooked.description: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, unenriched, cooked without salt

oatmeal-water.description: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, unenriched, cooked with water (includes boiling and microwaving), without salt

corn-porridge.description: Cereals, corn grits, yellow, regular and quick, enriched, cooked with water, without salt
corn-porridge.note: Yellow grits (Ukrainian corn grits are yellow; white grits 171655 = 71 kcal). US grits are cooked thinner than a thick mamalyga, so a stiff Ukrainian porridge will be denser than this; SR Legacy has no thicker cooked form.

pasta-cooked.description: Pasta, cooked, unenriched, without added salt
pasta-cooked.note: Hint named the enriched entry; Ukrainian pasta is not enriched. Same energy: enriched 169737 is also 158 kcal.

potato-boiled.description: Potatoes, boiled, cooked without skin, flesh, without salt

mashed-potatoes.description: Potatoes, mashed, home-prepared, whole milk and butter added

baked-potatoes.description: Potatoes, baked, flesh and skin, without salt

chicken-breast-cooked.description: Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted

chicken-leg-cooked.description: Chicken, broilers or fryers, leg, meat and skin, cooked, roasted
chicken-leg-cooked.note: USDA 'leg' = thigh + drumstick together. Thigh alone 173625 = 232 kcal, drumstick alone 173612 = 191 kcal.

roast-chicken.description: Chicken, broilers or fryers, meat and skin, cooked, roasted

turkey-breast-cooked.description: Turkey, retail parts, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted
turkey-breast-cooked.note: Retail breast fillet without added solution (how it is bought in Ukraine). Breast from a whole bird, roasted (171496) = 147 kcal.

pork-roast.description: Pork, fresh, loin, whole, separable lean and fat, cooked, roasted

pork-chop-cooked.description: Pork, fresh, loin, center loin (chops), bone-in, separable lean and fat, cooked, pan-fried

beef-cooked.description: Beef, round, bottom round, steak, separable lean and fat, trimmed to 0" fat, all grades, cooked, braised
beef-cooked.note: Boiled/stewed beef as served in Ukraine is mostly lean round or shoulder; braised chuck pot roast (168667) is 302 kcal, lean-only stew beef 191. Bottom round lean and fat (223) sits between them.

beef-liver-fried.description: Beef, variety meats and by-products, liver, cooked, pan-fried

salo.note: Fresh backfat. Salted salo carries a few % salt, so its energy is slightly lower (a few %). SR 'salt pork' (168287, 748) is belly-type, not backfat.

bacon-cooked.description: Pork, cured, bacon, pre-sliced, cooked, pan-fried
bacon-cooked.note: SR Legacy's only pan-fried bacon entry (the hint's description without 'pre-sliced' does not exist).

kovbasa.note: Fried form chosen because the row is 'домашня (смажена)'. Hint's 'Polish sausage, pork' (174577, as sold) = 326 kcal, within 2 %.

hake-cooked.note: Pollock stands for hake. This entry is analytical (3 samples, no additives) and pairs with ing-pollock-raw (173725). The hint's 'cooked, dry heat (may contain additives to retain moisture)' (173681, 111 kcal) is a recipe-approximated value (derivation RA) from additive-treated fish. True hake is slightly fattier: SR 'Fish, whiting, mixed species, cooked, dry heat' (175161, silver hake) = 116 kcal.

salmon-cooked.description: Fish, salmon, Atlantic, farmed, cooked, dry heat

mackerel-smoked.description: Fish, mackerel, Atlantic, cooked, dry heat
mackerel-smoked.note: SR Legacy has no smoked mackerel; cooked Atlantic mackerel used as the hint says. Hot-smoked is close to this; cold-smoked is wetter and lower.

tuna-canned.description: Fish, tuna, light, canned in water, drained solids (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
tuna-canned.note: Ukrainian canned tuna contains salt, so the regular entry. The 'without salt' entry (171986, 116 kcal) is an older, separate analysis, not just salt-free.

whole-milk.description: Milk, whole, 3.25% milkfat, without added vitamin A and vitamin D

white-bread.description: Bread, white, commercially prepared (includes soft bread crumbs)

lavash.note: SR Legacy has no lavash; white pita is the closest flatbread. Enriched pita (174915) is also 275 kcal.

oats-dry.description: Cereals, oats, regular and quick, not fortified, dry

pickled-cucumber.description: Pickles, cucumber, dill or kosher dill
pickled-cucumber.note: Brine-fermented 'sour' pickles (169379) = 11 kcal; same within 1 kcal.

tomato.description: Tomatoes, red, ripe, raw, year round average

zucchini.description: Squash, summer, zucchini, includes skin, raw

mixed-greens.note: Row also covers herbs: dill (172233) = 43, parsley (170416) = 36 kcal; lettuce value used.

green-peas.description: Peas, green (includes baby and lesuer types), canned, drained solids, unprepared

corn-canned.description: Corn, sweet, yellow, canned, whole kernel, drained solids

kidney-beans-cooked.description: Beans, kidney, all types, mature seeds, cooked, boiled, without salt

green-beans.description: Beans, snap, green, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

cauliflower.description: Cauliflower, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

broccoli-cooked.description: Broccoli, cooked, boiled, drained, without salt

apple.description: Apples, raw, with skin (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

currants.note: Red and white currants (173964) = 56 kcal. Ukrainian/Soviet tables list black currant near 44 kcal because they count only available sugars; USDA uses carbohydrate by difference (15.4 g), hence 63.

berries-mix.description: Mean of: Strawberries, raw; Raspberries, raw; Blueberries, raw
berries-mix.note: Unweighted mean of three SR Legacy foods: 167762 Strawberries, raw; 167755 Raspberries, raw; 171711 Blueberries, raw. Values: 167762 = 32, 167755 = 52, 171711 = 57 kcal.

grapes.description: Grapes, red or green (European type, such as Thompson seedless), raw

melon.note: Ukrainian melons are mostly honeydew-like; honeydew (169911) = 36 kcal.

raisins.description: Raisins, dark, seedless (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)
raisins.note: SR Legacy has no generic 'Raisins, seedless'; dark used. Golden (168164) = 301 kcal.

peanuts.description: Peanuts, all types, dry-roasted, without salt

sunflower-seeds.description: Seeds, sunflower seed kernels, dry roasted, without salt

pumpkin-seeds.description: Seeds, pumpkin and squash seed kernels, roasted, without salt

sunflower-oil.note: High-linoleic type (Ukrainian sunflower oil); every sunflower oil entry is 884 kcal.

juice.description: Apple juice, canned or bottled, unsweetened, without added ascorbic acid

black-coffee.description: Beverages, coffee, brewed, prepared with tap water

green-tea.description: Beverages, tea, black, brewed, prepared with tap water
green-tea.note: Row is 'Чай без цукру' (any tea); black tea is the usual one in Ukraine. Green tea (171917) is also 1 kcal.

ing-pork-shoulder-raw.description: Pork, fresh, shoulder, whole, separable lean and fat, raw

ing-pork-loin-raw.description: Pork, fresh, loin, whole, separable lean and fat, raw

ing-beef-chuck-raw.description: Beef, chuck, arm pot roast, separable lean and fat, trimmed to 1/8" fat, all grades, raw
ing-beef-chuck-raw.note: Lean-and-fat chuck (18 % fat). Fat-trimmed 'chuck for stew' raw (171206) is 128 kcal.

ing-beef-ground-raw.description: Beef, ground, 80% lean meat / 20% fat, raw

ing-chicken-whole-raw.description: Chicken, broilers or fryers, meat and skin, raw
ing-chicken-whole-raw.note: Per 100 g meat and skin (bones excluded).

ing-chicken-breast-raw.description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, raw

ing-beef-liver-raw.description: Beef, variety meats and by-products, liver, raw

ing-pork-hock-raw.description: Pork, fresh, variety meats and by-products, feet, raw
ing-pork-hock-raw.note: SR Legacy has no fresh hock; pork feet are the classic kholodets cut. Leg shank half, lean and fat, raw (168226) = 193 kcal. Per 100 g edible portion (bones excluded).

ing-smoked-pork-ribs.description: Pork, cured, shoulder, blade roll, separable lean and fat, unheated
ing-smoked-pork-ribs.note: SR Legacy has no smoked ribs. Blade roll is cured and smoked pork shoulder with a rib-like fat level (22 % fat); fresh spareribs, raw (167853) = 277 kcal. Per 100 g edible portion (bones excluded).

ing-pollock-raw.note: Stands for hake. Analytical, no additives. Hake is slightly fattier: 'Fish, whiting, mixed species, raw' (173713) = 90 kcal.

ing-wheat-flour.description: Wheat flour, white, all-purpose, enriched, unbleached
ing-wheat-flour.note: Unbleached, like Ukrainian flour. Bleached (168894) and unenriched (169761) are also 364 kcal.

ing-semolina-dry.note: Ukrainian 'манка М' is soft-wheat, closer to farina: 'Cereals, farina, unenriched, dry' (173916) = 369 kcal.

ing-corn-grits-dry.description: Cereals, corn grits, yellow, regular and quick, unenriched, dry

ing-rice-dry.description: Rice, white, long-grain, regular, raw, unenriched

ing-wheat-berries-dry.note: Hard red winter is Ukraine's main wheat. Other classes range 327-342 kcal (hard white 169719 = 342, durum 169721 = 339).

ing-split-peas-dry.description: Peas, green, split, mature seeds, raw

ing-tomato-paste.description: Tomato products, canned, paste, without salt added (Includes foods for USDA's Food Distribution Program)

ing-sorrel-raw.note: Dock = Rumex species, the genus of garden sorrel; SR Legacy has no separate sorrel.

ing-yeast-dry.description: Leavening agents, yeast, baker's, active dry

ing-dried-apples.note: Only uncooked dried-apple entry (sulfuring does not change energy); home-dried apples vary with moisture.

ing-potato-starch.note: No potato starch in SR Legacy or Foundation Foods (2026-04-30). Cornstarch is the closest pure starch, but it is drier (~8 % water) than potato starch (~16-20 % water), so real potato starch is about 330 kcal, ~13 % lower. 'Potato flour' (168446, 357 kcal) is whole dried potato, not starch.

ing-lard.note: The fat poured off when salo is rendered into shkvarky (entered as a negative amount).
